'''7 ABY''' was the seventh [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

==Events==
*The [[Bacta War]] began<ref name="X:KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> and ended.<ref name="X:BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
*The [[Hunt for Zsinj]] began.<ref name="X:WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
*Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]-turned-[[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Par Lankin]] lost control of the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[Gaeriel Captison]] was elected [[Prime Minister (Bakura)|Prime Minister]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], succeeding her uncle, [[Yeorg Captison]].
*42:10:1&mdash;[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] lead the successful [[Battle of New Alderaan (Hunt for Zsinj)|invasion]] on [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[Wedding of Corran Horn and Mirax Terrik]].<ref name="X:BW" />
*[[Wraith Squadron]] was formed.<ref name="X:WS" />
*[[Feena D'Asta]] was kidnapped by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and replaced with a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]].
*[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Betl Oxtroe]] makes secret overtures to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to transform the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] into a constitutional monarchy led by [[Ederlathh Pallopides/Legends|Ederlathh Pallopides]]; her assassination ends the peace talks.
